svg.title: Youssef & Maii - Cup: ILLUSTRATIVE flat development + recommended placement (NOT a manufacturer dieline)
svg.desc: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Frustum development computed from ESTIMATED dimensions (top Ø82, bottom Ø68, height 61 mm) derived from the 270 ml reference photo. Magenta = estimated blank outline; green dashed = assumed rim-curl (5 mm) and base-fold (6 mm) no-print bands; blue dashed = assumed 6 mm side-seam overlap; grey = front centre line. The crest is placed unwarped for placement reference; production artwork on a conical cup must be arc-distorted by the supplier to their dieline. FINAL DIELINE, PRINTABLE AREA, SCALE, BLEED AND SAFE AREA MUST BE CONFIRMED AGAINST THE MANUFACTURER'S TEMPLATE BEFORE PRODUCTION.

g.inkscape:label: GUIDES - ILLUSTRATIVE DEVELOPMENT - NOT A DIELINE (non-printing)
